text:
Nina (People Ops): FYI Priya is currently overseas for 2 weeks but expecting to start Mon. We need an I-9 plan that complies with USCIS. Options: embassy notary, authorized rep (local US renter/friend), or delay start. Thoughts?
Priya Nair (new hire): Hi all 95 I can return to SF but not before Tue. Embassy notary is a pain. I could ask my sister in SF to sign as an authorized representative if that's allowed.
Oliver (Backgrounds): Background flagged because the intake portal stripped diacritics from my last name (Nair vs NaAr?). That changed the name token and triggered a manual review. Priya, can you re-upload your passport scan with the exact unicode name?
Priya Nair (new hire): Uploaded new passport scan (high-res). Also attaching SSN letter screenshot.
Nina (People Ops): Re: authorized rep - USCIS allows an authorized representative to complete Section 2 when the employer cannot do in-person inspection. We require: rep name, company waiver form signed, and a photo of the rep's ID plus rep-signed attestation. I'll DM you the rep waiver template.
Rakesh (Hiring Manager): If authorized rep works, we won't delay onboarding. Can we also get laptop shipped to my office and have Priya pick it up when back? She prefers courier to hotel.
IT (Logistics): We can ship to the office or direct to home. If shipped to office, BadgeBot needs to add a 48h pick-up badge. Which address?
Priya Nair (new hire): Office pickup works best. Office address: 200 Townsend St, San Francisco, CA 94107. I'll pick up Tue afternoon.
IT-ShipBot: Shipping label queued: ship_to=200 Townsend St, SF, CA 94107; carrier=FedEx; service=overnight; note=Hold for pickup Priya Nair.
IT (Logistics): We'll image laptop with standard onboarding profile. Note: VPN and admin groups remain locked until I-9 cleared + background cleared.
Oliver (Backgrounds): With the new passport upload I re-ran the check. Manual review in progress; ETA 4 business hours. If the authorized rep form and rep ID are attached we'll mark I-9 pending verification and allow limited access after manager approval.
Nina (People Ops): Benefits enrollment question from Priya You need to complete enrollment within 30 days of start; we can create a provisional enrollment if SSN pending but payroll needs SSN for tax forms. Priya please complete the W-4 and state withholding with "pending SSN" note and attach SSN card when available.
Priya Nair (new hire): Got it. I'll fill W-4 now. Also sending my sister's info for authorized rep: name Anjali Nair, phone on file.
Nina (People Ops): Received. Action items: 1) Priya upload rep-signed waiver + rep ID photo (Priya DONE?). 2) Oliver finish manual background review. 3) IT ship laptop to office (queued). 4) BadgeBot create 48h pickup pass. 5) Payroll flag for provisional benefits pending SSN.
Priya Nair (new hire): Waiver & rep ID uploaded 697 thanks.
BadgeBot: 48-hour pickup pass created for priya.nair@redwood.com 4DD QR emailed.
Oliver (Backgrounds): Manual check passed — name normalization issue resolved. Background cleared pending SSN verification for payroll (soft clear).
Nina (People Ops): Great. Jonah  IT please hold VPN/admin until People Ops updates "i9_cleared": we only set "full access" after physical sign-off or authorized rep attestation verified.
IT (Logistics): Copy. We'll enable limited build/test groups for day 1 and enable full access after clearance flag.
Rakesh (Hiring Manager): Day-1 schedule reminder: 9:30am PT team sync, 10:15 benefits walkthrough, 11:00 manager 1:1. Priya welcome aboard!
Priya Nair (new hire): Thanks everyone 60A I'll be on the 9:30 sync. See you then.
Nina (People Ops): Closing thread: background = soft-cleared, I-9 using authorized rep = submitted, laptop in transit to office, benefits & payroll flagged. I'll update the tracker and close when SSN and rep attestation are verified.
